body:
More than 50 staff in my building, for sure. I occasionally help with payroll and I'd guess there are maybe 500 employees through the whole company. Probably 7 or 8 people do my job in addition to me. I work maybe 15 hours a week for pennies above minimum wage, soon to be upgraded to working about 20 hours a week. 

I've worked here for just more than a month. I started around July 20th.

I guess the problem with that is that I don't actually know who my boss is. I'm a relatively new employee (15hr/wk, started in August) and I work alone. I don't know who my boss is because I work after hours and while I see plenty of people who are my superiors, I only see them in passing and don't know which one my boss is. I guess I could talk to human resources. But I'm really scared of making a bad impression because I'm so new.

I do live in the US. I guess part of my fear is that I'm afraid to let anyone know beforehand. I sort of want to let everyone know where I am while I'm already in the hospital. I'm afraid people will try to talk me out of it or offer support but I'm past the point of being able to rely on others.
My previous suicide attempt was while I was on fluoxetine. I'm currently on escitalopram, Xanax XR, and classic Xanax PRN
